name: privacy
description: Sanitize metadata and process private local images or videos with content-blind workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Process private media locally without content access
interface.longDescription: Audit and remove private metadata from local images or videos, compress or convert video, probe technical properties, and split video through local content-blind commands while prohibiting the agent from seeing raw metadata, viewing, hearing, transcribing, or uploading media content.
defaultPrompt: Compress this private local video without inspecting its content.
Split this private local video into 10-second files without inspecting its content.
Remove private metadata from this local image or video without revealing its values.
